style: Semi-realistic stylized 2D hand painted dark fantasy medieval village. Single adult full body, front three quarter view, portrait 2:3, isolated transparent alpha background, detailed clothing, muted earth colors, warm bronze rim light. No text, no role card or werewolf symbols.
